title: Functional correlation bound for random Lasota--Yorke maps with holes and its applications to conditional normal approximations
summary: This paper investigates the statistical properties of random open dynamical systems generated by families of Lasota--Yorke maps. Open systems, in which trajectories may escape through `holes', model transient phenomena and present additional difficulties for statistical analysis because the underlying ensemble loses mass over time. We show that the framework of functional correlation bounds (FCB), originally developed for closed systems, can also be adapted to this random open setting.
